zh.ONE_LINER_2_LINE_SUBTITLE: 它卖的不是笔记软件，是「你的知识以任何 AI 都读得懂的格式，躺在你自己硬盘上」
zh.SNAPSHOT_ONE_TO_TWO_SENTENCE_DEFINITION: 官网首页的说法是「a private and secure space for your thoughts」，定价页写「Free without limits. No sign-up required. No strings attached.」。产品本体可以拆成四件事：本地 Markdown 文件夹（vault）、双向链接与图谱、10,194 个社区插件、两个可选收费服务（Sync / Publish）。它不托管你的内容、不收集遥测（官网隐私问答原话：our apps do not collect telemetry data, and we never sell user data）。
zh.USER_PROMISE: 官网原话是「Sharpen your thinking」；落到功能承诺上是三句：免费、私密、永远属于你。
zh.CATEGORY: 本地优先知识管理（PKM）· AI 上下文底座
zh.CATEGORY_POSITIONING_PARAGRAPH: 一个反常识的定位事实：官网首页、定价页、Sync 页、Publish 页全都没有 AI 功能位，官方从不把自己归到 AI 工具类目里。但它的用户把它当 AI 底座用——PH 的 AI 评论摘要原句是「fit with AI workflows because the files are easy for other tools to read」，一位 8 条评论的用户写「Obsidian is not just a note-taking app. It is a notebook for AI」。产品自己不宣称，用户替它宣称，这是本篇最值得记的一点。
zh.ASSUMPTION_1: AI 能力评分用的是「内置 vs 社区」口径：社区插件 10,194 个、AI 分类 1,214 个，数量来自社区站计数，不代表质量或可用度
zh.ASSUMPTION_2: 本次 20 分钟实测未执行（老板还没做），体验段只使用公开评论证据，不打体感分、不写虚假的秒数
zh.ASSUMPTIONS_ONE_PARAGRAPH_LIST_WHAT_IS_I: 两类输入：（1）可核实的公开材料，官网首页、定价、Sync、Publish、企业版、社区插件目录、PH 175 条、G2 14 条、G2 替代品页；（2）一手实测，由燃冰于 2026-11-10 完成。凡无公开依据的标 [推断] 并写依据；凡我的判断标（我的判断）；不写假精度。
zh.STAGE_MATURITY: 成熟期（2020-05-27 首次登上 PH，已 5 次发布，最近一次是 2025-08-20 的 Bases）
zh.USER_SCALE: 官方未公开活跃用户数 · PH 4.9 / 175 条评价 / 4.4K 关注 · G2 4.5 / 14 条 · 官网 Enterprise 页口径：10,000+ 组织购买了商业许可
zh.SEGMENT_1_NAME: 个人知识工作者（研究者 / 写作者 / 学生）
zh.SEGMENT_1_DETAIL: G2 与 PH 评论里的典型场景：论文、代码库文档、写书、日记。一位医学生抱怨图谱插件有节点上限——说明重度个人研究者是真实用户群。
zh.SEGMENT_2_NAME: 把 vault 当 AI 上下文的工程师
zh.SEGMENT_2_DETAIL: PH 3 条评论的用户原话：「it turned out to be the best place to keep context for AI tools... My agent setup reads the same vault I write in by hand. No sync layer, no API, no format negotiation.」这类人不用它的 AI 功能，用它的文件格式。
zh.SEGMENT_3_NAME: 受合规或保密约束的个人（企业内自下而上）
zh.SEGMENT_3_DETAIL: Enterprise 页的客户墙包括 Amazon、Meta、Microsoft、NVIDIA、UK Government、US Bank、Siemens。注意口径：这是「购买商业许可的组织数」，不等于全员部署，也不代表 Obsidian 接触了他们的数据。
zh.JTBD_FUNCTIONAL: 把手边读过想过的东西，存在一个十年后还打得开的地方
zh.JTBD_EMOTIONAL: 「我受够了一次次要琢磨怎么把笔记搬出来」——怕被平台绑架
zh.JTBD_SOCIAL: 在别人面前显得有自己的一套知识体系（而不是一堆散落的 App）
zh.TRIGGER_MOMENT: 两个时刻：一是某次换工具发现导出不干净；二是开始用 AI，发现需要喂给它一个像样的上下文库
zh.FREQUENCY: 写作与记录是每天；AI 相关使用发生在外部工具里，频率取决于用户的 AI 习惯
zh.USAGE_CONTEXT: 晨间日记、会议纪要、读书笔记、项目资料、写作草稿、给 agent 喂上下文的工程目录
zh.ACQUISITION_LOOP_DETAIL: 官方未披露渠道结构。可核实的三条入口：① 社区口碑——PH 评论里有人写自己是在 Reddit 帖子里被一句「Just use Obsidian」带进来的；② 社区插件与主题作者自带的流量（10,194 插件 / 1,000 主题）；③ PH 上 5 次发布，最近 Bases 拿到 435 赞。
zh.AHA_MOMENT_DETAIL: 发现自己写的笔记就是一个 .md 文件，用记事本也能打开、用脚本也能读——所有权是能被感知到的（这条来自评论共识，不是实测）
zh.VIRALITY_DETAIL_OR_NONE: 有弱传播：Publish 能把笔记发布成网站，但官方对 Publish 的定价是 $8/站/月，说明它不打算做免费病毒环。真正被分享的是「我的 vault 长什么样」（截图、模板、插件清单），分享物不是链接而是配置。
zh.RETENTION_1: 文件在本地：迁移等于复制一个文件夹（这是最低的锁定，也是最反直觉的留存设计）
zh.RETENTION_2: 真正难搬的是插件组合与 vault 结构——一位用户说自己花了整整一周定制模板才顺手
zh.RETENTION_3: 每日笔记的习惯沉淀：评论里出现「It's usually the first thing I open in the morning」
zh.GROWTH_LOOP_1_DETAIL: 社区站 10,194 个插件、1,000 个主题，其中 AI 分类 1,214 个。插件作者在别处（YouTube / 公众号 / GitHub）自带受众，等于把分发外包给了生态。转化数据未披露。
zh.GROWTH_LOOP_2_DETAIL: PH 评论原句：「Deep in a Reddit thread one night, a voice of reason suggested: 'Just use Obsidian.'」——它的获客发生在别人的讨论区，不在自己的官网。
zh.LOOP_TRIGGER_DETAIL: 有个想法 / 读到一段东西 / 开会要记
zh.LOOP_ACTION_DETAIL: 新建一篇 .md，用 [[链接]] 挂到已有的笔记上
zh.LOOP_REWARD_DETAIL: 笔记连起来了：图谱多一个节点，反向链接面板多一条引用；或者你的 agent 能直接读到这一段
zh.LOOP_RETURN_DETAIL: 文件在原地不动，攒得越多越舍不得走；换工具的成本随时间上升
zh.LOOP_ONE_LINE_INSIGHT_WHAT_THE_LOOP_ACTU: 这个循环教用户的是：所有权比功能更值钱。所以它真正的产品不是编辑器，是那份「格式承诺」——AI 越强，这份承诺越贵。
zh.LOOP_FREQ_NOTE_TRIGGER_CONTEXT: 写是每天；AI 调用发生在别的工具里，不是产品内的动作
zh.SURFACE_1_ROLE: 不是数据库视图，就是磁盘上的文件夹——信息架构 = 文件系统
zh.SURFACE_2_ROLE: Live Preview 与源码模式双态，Markdown 原样即存储格式
zh.SURFACE_3_ROLE: 把 [[链接]] 变成可看的网络，是它的情绪价值入口
zh.SURFACE_4_ROLE: 无限白板（2022-12 发布），把卡片和网页嵌进去自由排布
zh.SURFACE_5_ROLE: 2025-08 发布的新模块：把任意一组笔记变成数据库视图——这是它第一次正式回应 Notion 的数据库
zh.SURFACE_6_ROLE: 10,194 个插件的事实入口，也是它最大的不确定来源
zh.IA_LOGIC_PARAGRAPH: 没有数据库抽象层。文件夹和链接就是全部结构，插件是外挂件。这种「没有 IA 的 IA」是刻意的：它保证内容在十年后仍然可读，代价是所有结构化能力都得靠用户自己长出来。
zh.NAV_INTERACTION_PARAGRAPH: 两个输入框承担全部导航：Ctrl+P 命令面板（执行任何动作）与 [[ 补全（跳到任何笔记）。学不会这两个，产品就等于没打开。
zh.CRAFT_1_DETAIL: 没有私有格式、没有导出流程，这决定了它在 AI 时代的可读性优势——G2 一位 4 星用户原话：「Claude processes .md files more effectively than pdf or docx」
zh.CRAFT_2_NAME: 双向链接 + 反向链接面板
zh.CRAFT_2_DETAIL: [[ 一敲即连，反向链接把「谁引用了我」变成常驻视图——这是 PKM 一代的共同遗产，它做得最稳
zh.CRAFT_3_DETAIL: 官方只守内核（编辑、链接、同步），把长尾需求全部让给社区。功能覆盖度靠 10,194 个插件堆出来，官方团队规模得以极小
zh.CRAFT_4_DETAIL: 把链接关系画成图，实用价值被用户反复质疑（「graph section feels very plain」），但它是产品被传播得最广的一张图
zh.CRAFT_5_DETAIL: Markdown 标记在光标离开时立刻渲染成排版，既保留源码可控，又不牺牲阅读体感
zh.CRAFT_PRINCIPLE: 它所有的手艺都指向一件事：让「数据归你」变成不需要解释的默认值。功能是第二位的。
zh.TTV_NOTE_WHAT_HAPPENS_AT_AHA: 实测（燃冰）：vault 建好后到能写第一篇 1 分钟。从下载安装那一段没测，不给数字。
zh.TRUST_LABEL: 信任机制：无注册无遥测（可核实）
zh.DELIGHT_1: 第一次看到自己的笔记连成一张图（评论高频提到的情绪点）
zh.DELIGHT_2: 发现文件能被 Claude / Codex 直接读，不用导出（PH 用户原话：notebook for AI）
zh.DELIGHT_3: 不催升级、不弹更新、不逼注册（PH 原话：never nags me to upgrade or sign up）
zh.STRUGGLE_1: 空白画布，零引导（G2 5 星用户 dislike 原话）；实测（燃冰）：装完根本不会启动
zh.STRUGGLE_2: 双链要人记。实测（燃冰）：「并不太会用双链，需要人记忆」
zh.STRUGGLE_3: 实测（燃冰）：搞了几个月才悟出怎么用——它不是难用，是没有入口
zh.REVENUE_MODEL_NAME: 免费核心 + 可选服务订阅 + 自愿许可
zh.REVENUE_MODEL_DETAIL: 官方定价页（2026-11 核实）：Sync $4/人/月（年付）、Publish $8/站/月（年付）、Catalyst $25 一次性、Commercial $50/人/年。Sync 与 Publish 支持 7 天无理由退款；Catalyst、Commercial 与 Credit 不退。教育/学生/非营利：Sync 与 Publish 40% 折扣，官方写明不发其他折扣。
zh.BUSINESS_MODEL_SHORT: 软件白送，卖同步与发布
zh.MON_ENTRY_HEADLINE: 增值服务收费，不是功能闸门
zh.MON_ENTRY_DETAIL: 定价页的免费档写着「Free without limits」，没有任何功能被锁；付费买的是两件「跨边界」的事：跨设备（Sync）与对外（Publish）。这是少见的、没有把核心功能当筹码的定价结构。
zh.FREE_PAID_DETAIL: 单机一辈子免费；一旦要手机电脑同步、要让外人看到，就要付钱。实测（燃冰）：完全不付费也能跑，因为他用外部 AI 把别的渠道的文件同步进本地文件夹，再定期备份移动硬盘——官方不堵这个口子，等于自愿让掉一块收入。
zh.UX_MON_HEADLINE: 基本对齐，有一处结构性让步
zh.UX_MON_DETAIL_ARE_THEY_ALIGNED_OR_IN_TEN: 对齐的部分：没有升级催prompt、没有功能阉割，用户越用越信任，越信任越愿意买 Sync。错位的一处：它把「多设备」做成了付费点，而多设备是 2020 年代的基础期待，所以这块收入天然会被自建方案侵蚀（我的判断）。
zh.COMP_INTRO: 以下对比是我的主观判断，不是评分或测量。AI 内置度这一列按「官方是否内置」评，不按社区插件评。
zh.COMP_WHERE_OWN_WINS: 格式所有权与生态规模：Logseq 官网自述 150+ 插件，Obsidian 社区站是 10,194 个——差两个数量级，这不是功能差，是生态差。
zh.COMP_WHERE_RIVALS_CATCH: 一切「意思级」的能力：语义检索、自动结构化、开箱即用的 AI 对话。Capacities 用「一切都是 object」做了自动关联，Tana 直接转向会议 agent，Notion 把 AI 做成页面平级模块。Obsidian 在这一层是空的，而且看起来不打算填。
zh.CHANNEL_1: 口碑社区的第三方讨论区（Reddit / YouTube / Discord）
zh.CHANNEL_2: 社区插件与主题作者的自带流量（10,194 插件 / 1,000 主题）
zh.CHANNEL_3: PH 发布节奏（5 次，Bases 435 赞 / 1.0 版 578 赞）
zh.HORIZONTAL_1: 官方页：Sync（跨设备）与 Publish（发布网站）
zh.HORIZONTAL_2: 官方页：Enterprise（客户墙，10,000+ 组织，导航里是独立一级入口）
zh.VERTICAL_1: 教育/学生/非营利：Sync 与 Publish 40% 折扣（定价页 FAQ 原文）
zh.VERTICAL_2: 开发者：官方 Developer 文档 + Web Clipper + CLI，长尾集成交给社区
zh.PLATFORM_1: 插件 API / 主题 / CSS 片段：公开文档，任何人可发插件
zh.PLATFORM_2: 本地文件格式本身就是 API：脚本、agent、其他编辑器都能直接读写（用户评论里的实际用法）
zh.CURRENT_AI_USAGE_PARAGRAPH: 官方零内置 AI，可核实：首页、定价页、Sync/Publish 页都没有 AI 功能，定价里也没有 AI 额度。AI 靠用户自己装：社区 AI 分类 1,214 个插件。实测（燃冰）的做法更极端，他不装插件，而是让外部 AI 直接读本地库——AI 不在产品里，在用户手里。
zh.AGENTIC_CANDIDATE_1: 未上线（我的判断）：官方提供 MCP server 或 CLI，让 agent 原生读写 vault
zh.AGENTIC_CANDIDATE_2: 未上线（我的判断）：Sync 升级为「给 AI 用的上下文同步」，而不只是设备间同步
zh.AGENTIC_CANDIDATE_3: 未上线（我的判断）：vault 结构可读性检查（告诉用户哪些笔记 AI 读不懂）
zh.AI_OPPORTUNITY_1: （我的判断）先做「AI 可读性」而不是「AI 功能」：给 vault 打分、提示哪些笔记缺结构，这是它唯一不用撒谎的 AI 位置
zh.AI_OPPORTUNITY_2: （我的判断）把 1,214 个 AI 插件做官方精选与安全审计，收编生态的解释权
zh.AI_DISRUPTION_RISK: （我的判断）真正的威胁不是竞品做 AI，而是 AI 客户端自己长出文件系统权限：当 Claude / ChatGPT 能直接读写本地文件夹，用户就不需要「笔记软件」，只需要「文件夹」。对它这是利好（格式更值钱）也是死局（编辑器可被绕过）。
zh.METRICS_INTRO: Obsidian 不做遥测（官网明说），所以它自己也没有完整数据。以下是推断，用来解释它的产品行为，不等于官方事实。
zh.NORTH_STAR_METRIC: 周活跃 vault 数 [推断]
zh.NORTH_STAR_WHY: 推断依据：无注册、无遥测，官方唯一能间接观测到的是 Sync/Publish 订阅与插件下载；「周活跃 vault」是这两个代理指标的共同上游
zh.INPUT_METRIC_1_NAME: 付费 Sync 订阅数 [推断]
zh.INPUT_METRIC_1_WHY: 推断依据：Sync 是它最稳定的经常性收入，$4/人/月按人计
zh.INPUT_METRIC_2_NAME: 商业许可购买组织数 [推断]
zh.INPUT_METRIC_2_WHY: 推断依据：Enterprise 页写「More than 10,000 organizations」，这是官网唯一露出的规模数字
zh.INPUT_METRIC_3_WHY: 推断依据：生态热度是它获客的前置条件，社区站公开插件数可作趋势代理
zh.GUARDRAIL_METRIC: 启动速度与插件稳定性 [推断]
zh.GUARDRAIL_WHY: 推断依据：G2 多条 dislike 指向「插件装多了启动变慢」「插件更新会坏」——这是它最不能崩的一条体验
zh.METRIC_BLINDSPOT_WHY: 实测（燃冰）用了几个月才跨过去。它对产品本身不设遥测，也看不见这批人。
zh.FRICTION_1_BODY_WHY_IT_MATTERS: 实测（燃冰）：四月开始用，最初连文件夹和仓库的区别都不懂，搞了几个月才悟出用法。G2 5 星用户也写「starts as a blank slate」。
zh.FRICTION_2_TITLE: 学习曲线是第一大抱怨
zh.FRICTION_2_BODY: PH Cons 里 learning curve 12 条，排第一。有用户说自己「spent probably an entire week customizing it」，期间并没有在写东西。
zh.FRICTION_3_TITLE: 插件是税，不是免费午餐
zh.FRICTION_3_BODY: PH 用户原话：「a vault held together by nine community plugins is a vault that breaks in nine ways」；G2 也有人写「advanced queries, tables, kanban rely on community plugins, which can break on updates」。生态的规模优势同时是脆性来源。
zh.FRICTION_4_TITLE: 搜索只匹配文字，不匹配意思
zh.FRICTION_4_BODY: PH 3 条评论的用户原话：「It finds strings well and ideas badly. If I remember roughly what I thought but not what I typed, I am stuck browsing.」——这正好是 AI 该补的位置，而官方没补。
zh.RISK_INTRO: 只列有公开依据的风险；概率与严重度是我的判断，不做量化。
zh.RISK_1_NAME: AI 客户端长出文件系统权限
zh.RISK_1_LIK: 已有苗头：用户直接让 agent 读 vault
zh.RISK_1_MIT: 把「格式所有权」升级成「格式标准」，主动出 MCP/CLI（我的建议）
zh.RISK_2_LIK: G2/PH 均有多条插件损坏与安全担忧
zh.RISK_2_MIT: AI 类插件做官方审计与精选（我的建议）
zh.RISK_3_NAME: 无遥测 = 无产品迭代数据
zh.RISK_3_MIT: 做可选的本地诊断（用户自愿上传）（我的建议）
zh.RISK_4_NAME: 团队协作缺位，企业场景让位
zh.RISK_4_LIK: G2 原话：shared vaults 不是顺畅的实时协作，容易产生冲突
zh.RISK_4_MIT: 不与 Notion 抢协作，守住「个人 + 自愿合规采购」（我的建议）
zh.OPP_1_DETAIL_WHAT_HOW_WHY: （我的判断）第一次启动给三条路：从别的工具导入 / 空白开始 / 用模板。成本极低，直击 PH 与 G2 共同的第一抱怨。
zh.OPP_2_HEADLINE: 把「AI 可读性」做成一等公民
zh.OPP_2_DETAIL: （我的判断）不造 AI，造「AI 能读懂」的检查与建议：哪些笔记缺标题、缺链接、缺标签。这是它唯一不用和模型厂商竞争的 AI 位置。
zh.OPP_3_DETAIL: （我的判断）把搜索从「匹配文字」升级成「匹配意思」，挂在 Sync 订阅里——它已有 1,214 个 AI 插件证明需求存在，官方缺的只是收编。
zh.STRATEGIC_HEADLINE: 从「笔记软件」升级成「AI 的本地上下文标准」
zh.STRATEGIC_DETAIL_HIGH_IMPACT_BET: （我的判断）不去做 AI 功能，去做「让所有 AI 都能读」的协议位置：MCP 通道、文件约定、可读性规范。谁定义格式，谁在 AI 时代收租。
zh.MOONSHOT_HEADLINE: 让 vault 成为 agent 的默认工作目录
zh.MOONSHOT_DETAIL_WHY_IT_COULD_RESHAPE_THE: （我的判断）如果 agent 的默认行为是「在你的 vault 里工作」，那 Obsidian 就从「一个 App」变成「一层基础设施」——这才是它 10,194 个插件的真正终局价值。
zh.FINAL_WINS: 文件所有权 + 生态规模：格式谁都能读，插件谁都能写，两边互相加固
zh.FINAL_BREAKS: 一切「意思级」能力缺席：语义搜索、自动结构化、内置 AI 对话——而且官方结构上不打算做
zh.FINAL_MOAT_OR_LACK_THEREOF: 它的护城河是格式，不是功能。功能会被追平，格式不会——AI 越强，纯文本越值钱。这是罕见的「护城河随技术进步变宽」的产品。
zh.VERDICT_ONE_LINER: Notion 是文档即数据，Obsidian 是文档即连结。
zh.VERDICT_BODY_2_3_LINES: 可核实：官方零内置 AI，AI 插件 1,214 个由社区提供；官方四个对比页全部 404，它不做竞品对比；免费版无限制、不注册也能用。实测（燃冰）：建库到写第一篇 1 分钟，但真正会用花了几个月。我的判断：它把 AI 让给了外部，自己不承担这件事，这既是它的开放，也是它不涨的墙。
zh.MOAT_REASONING_ONE_LINE: 格式所有权 9 分、生态规模 9 分、AI 能力 3 分，加权 8
zh.TLDR_1_HEADLINE: 官方不做 AI，用户替它做
zh.TLDR_1_BODY: 内置 AI 为零，社区 AI 插件 1,214 个；用户把它当「notebook for AI」
zh.TLDR_2_HEADLINE: 护城河是格式，不是功能
zh.TLDR_2_BODY: 纯文本 + 本地文件夹：换工具成本极低，但换掉它等于放弃所有 AI 能读的上下文
zh.TLDR_3_BODY: 搜索匹配文字不匹配意思；语义层是它唯一空着、也是 AI 时代最贵的一格
zh.SHOT_1_CAPTION: 官网头图：private thoughts，私密是这个产品的第一句话
zh.SHOT_2_CAPTION: Canvas 里的哲学家卡片——它展示的是「知识可以被摆布」，不是功能清单
zh.SHOT_3_CAPTION: 把维基页面嵌进白板：本地文件也可以装下整个互联网的碎片
zh.SHOT_4_CAPTION: Sync：共享 vault 与跨设备，$4/人/月（年付）
zh.SHOT_5_CAPTION: Publish 出来的站点——它的对外出口是收费的
zh.SHOT_6_CAPTION: Publish 的成品页面：没有技术知识也能发布（定价页原话）

extra_zh.title: 对标竞品地图
extra_zh.body:
先看一个可核实的事实。Obsidian 官网有 /compare、/vs、/alternatives、/switch 四个路径，逐个打开全部 404。它不做竞品对比页。

这件事说明它不靠商战获客，靠的是口碑和搜索。反过来，G2 的「替代品」页给了一份名单，Evernote、Slack、Microsoft Teams、monday、ClickUp。这个名单很值得看一眼，因为它不是竞品，是「同一批人同时在用的工具组合」。G2 是按评论共现算的，不是按需求重合算的。

谁抢的哪一段它更近的地方
Notion团队知识库与协作多人、权限、企业采购
Capacities对象化个人知识开箱即用，不用自己搭结构
Logseq大纲式本地笔记日记流与块级引用
Anytype本地加密的对象空间隐私与端到端加密
Roam Research网络化思维笔记早期的双链范式
Evernote / 印象笔记沉淀型收集存量用户与剪藏习惯

我的判断，真正在同一格的是 Capacities、Logseq、Anytype 这三个。Notion 不在同一格，因为它是团队的；Evernote 那批是上一代的遗存。Obsidian 的对手其实不是任何一个产品，是「用户懒得折腾」这件事。

extra_zh.title: 竞品技术底座
extra_zh.body:
技术底子决定它接得住什么，也决定它会不会被替换。

产品底座被锁住的能力
Obsidian本地 Markdown 文件 + 插件运行时，无自有云格式所有权。文件永远可读，AI 越强它越值钱
NotionBlock 树 + 关系型数据库 + 权限结构化与团队协作
Capacities对象库 + 日期关联，云端开箱结构与自动关联
Logseq大纲 + 本地 Markdown块级引用与日记流
Anytype本地加密对象 + 自建同步隐私与去中心化

[推断] Obsidian 的技术底子几乎不为 AI 做任何事，但它做对了一件更难的事，把数据放在一个任何 AI 都能读的格式里。所以它的护城河不是功能，是格式。功能三个月被追平，格式不会，而且 AI 越强，纯文本越值钱。

代价也很清楚。插件是税，PH 上有人原话写「靠九个社区插件撑起来的库，会在九个地方坏」。这不是技术债，是架构选择的后遗症。

extra_zh.title: 可迁移的机会
extra_zh.body:
这一节全是我的判断。

它弱在哪换到哪会带来什么机会
没有入口，几个月才悟出用法入职、换工具、内容迁移做「帮人把库搭起来」的服务或工具，一单一次，不用做 SaaS
插件是税，出问题要自己排查非技术用户、行业从业者预配置好的场景库，卖的是「开箱就对」，不是自由度
同步要钱，且被 iCloud 绕过多设备但不想付订阅的人本地优先 + 按需同步的轻方案，但撞在官方的免费策略上，很难收费
非文本资料（视频、图文、扫描件）处理弱研究型、投研型用户把非文本变成可检索文本的前置层，这是它主动让出的场景

我的判断，最轻的是第一个。它跟我自己的处境一样，我四月开始用，卡在入口。这个卡点是可以被服务化的。

extra_zh.title: 流量与变现拆解
extra_zh.body:
框架来自我在 GetNote 里写的《关于流量变现交易的商业逻辑思考笔记》，三问，钱从谁兜里出、还能拿多久、凭什么你拿到。

套利三问Obsidian 的答案依据
钱从谁兜里出个人用户的订阅，不是企业预算。Sync $4/人/月、Publish $8/站/月、Catalyst $25 一次性、Commercial $50/人/年官方定价页
还能拿多久[推断] 只要纯文本还是 AI 最友好的格式，这个位置就稳；风险在于 AI 产品自己开始吃笔记这个场景官方零 AI 功能，社区 1,214 个 AI 插件
凭什么你拿到结构性套利。它用十年时间攒下「本地 + 免费 + 可扩展」这三件信任资产，别人短期堆不出来不做竞品对比页，也不买量

流量这一侧：几乎不吃爆款，吃的是长尾。插件目录、教程、YouTube 测评、SEO，都是别人替它铺的。它的增长不是投放出来的，是社区自己长出来的。

变现这一侧：软件白送，卖的是「跨设备」和「对公开」。这个结构的问题在于，它只有一个收费理由（同步），而同步恰恰是最容易被 iCloud、Git、坚果云绕过的一环。实测（燃冰）就是零付费用户，他压根没这个需求。

[推断] 所以它最脆的一根梁不是 AI 缺失，是它没有第二个收费理由。AI 时代本来可以是第二个理由，但它把这个理由让给了社区。

zh.metrics_zh:
价值到达时间
1 分钟
实测（燃冰）：vault 建好到能写第一篇 1 分钟；从下载安装那一段没测，不给数
核心循环频次 [推断]
日
推断依据：笔记是日频动作；双链与图谱是低频，靠提醒才会用
护城河评分 [我的评分]
8/10
格式所有权 9、生态规模 9、AI 能力 3，加权 8。这是主观评分，不是测量

en.ONE_LINER_2_LINE_SUBTITLE: It doesn't sell note-taking. It sells the fact that your knowledge sits on your own disk in a format any AI can read.
en.SNAPSHOT_ONE_TO_TWO_SENTENCE_DEFINITION: The homepage calls it "a private and secure space for your thoughts"; the pricing page says "Free without limits. No sign-up required. No strings attached." The product is four things: a local Markdown folder (a vault), bidirectional links plus a graph, 10,194 community plugins, and two optional paid services (Sync and Publish). It does not host your content and does not collect telemetry (their own privacy FAQ: "our apps do not collect telemetry data, and we never sell user data").
en.USER_PROMISE: The brand line is "Sharpen your thinking". The functional promise is three words: free, private, forever yours.
en.CATEGORY: Local-first knowledge management (PKM) · AI context substrate
en.CATEGORY_POSITIONING_PARAGRAPH: A counter-intuitive positioning fact: the homepage, pricing page, Sync page and Publish page contain no AI feature slot at all. The company never files itself under AI tools. Its users do it for them — Product Hunt's AI summary reads "fit with AI workflows because the files are easy for other tools to read", and one reviewer with 8 reviews wrote "Obsidian is not just a note-taking app. It is a notebook for AI." The product stays silent, the users make the claim. That gap is the most interesting thing in this teardown.
en.ASSUMPTION_1: The AI score uses a "built-in vs community" lens: 10,194 plugins and 1,214 in the AI category, both counted on the community site. Counts do not equal quality or usability.
en.ASSUMPTION_2: The 20-minute hands-on test was not run this time, so the experience section relies only on public review evidence — no invented timings, no made-up feel scores.
en.ASSUMPTIONS_ONE_PARAGRAPH_LIST_WHAT_IS_I: Two inputs: verifiable public material (homepage, pricing, Sync, Publish, Enterprise, plugin directory, 175 PH reviews, 14 G2 reviews, G2 alternatives page) and a hands-on test by RanBing on 2026-11-10. Anything without public evidence is marked [inferred] with its basis; judgement is marked (my call); no fake precision.
en.STAGE_MATURITY: Mature (first launched on Product Hunt 2020-05-27; five launches, the latest being Bases on 2025-08-20)
en.USER_SCALE: Active users not disclosed · Product Hunt 4.9 from 175 reviews, 4.4K followers · G2 4.5 from 14 reviews · Enterprise page claims 10,000+ organizations hold a commercial license
en.SEGMENT_1_DETAIL: The recurring jobs in G2 and Product Hunt reviews: theses, codebase docs, books, journals. One medical student complains the graph plugin caps how many nodes it renders — heavy individual researchers are a real segment.
en.SEGMENT_2_NAME: Engineers who use a vault as AI context
en.SEGMENT_2_DETAIL: A Product Hunt reviewer writes: "it turned out to be the best place to keep context for AI tools... My agent setup reads the same vault I write in by hand. No sync layer, no API, no format negotiation." These people do not use its AI features, they use its file format.
en.SEGMENT_3_NAME: Individuals under compliance or confidentiality constraints (bottom-up inside companies)
en.SEGMENT_3_DETAIL: The Enterprise page logo wall lists Amazon, Meta, Microsoft, NVIDIA, UK Government, US Bank and Siemens. Read the scope carefully: that is the count of organizations holding a commercial license, not full deployment, and not evidence that Obsidian ever touches their data.
en.JTBD_FUNCTIONAL: Keep what I read and think in one place that will still open in ten years
en.JTBD_EMOTIONAL: "I'm tired of wondering how I'd ever get my notes out of this thing" — fear of being held hostage
en.JTBD_SOCIAL: Look like someone with an actual knowledge system, not five scattered apps
en.TRIGGER_MOMENT: Two moments: a failed export that scares you, and the day you start using AI and need to feed it a decent context library
en.FREQUENCY: Writing and capture are daily; AI usage happens in external tools and depends on the user's own AI habits
en.USAGE_CONTEXT: Morning journal, meeting notes, reading notes, project material, drafts, and the engineering folder that feeds an agent its context
en.ACQUISITION_LOOP_DETAIL: The channel mix is not disclosed. Three verifiable entry points: (1) word of mouth — a Product Hunt reviewer describes being pulled in by a single line in a Reddit thread, "Just use Obsidian"; (2) the built-in audience of plugin and theme authors (10,194 plugins, 1,000 themes); (3) five Product Hunt launches, the latest (Bases) taking 435 upvotes.
en.AHA_MOMENT_DETAIL: Realizing your notes are just .md files — Notepad can open them, a script can read them. Ownership you can actually feel. (This is review consensus, not a test result.)
en.VIRALITY_DETAIL_OR_NONE: Weak virality. Publish can turn notes into a website, but it is priced at $8 per site per month, so there is no free viral loop by design. What actually gets shared is "what my vault looks like" — screenshots, templates, plugin lists. The shared artifact is a configuration, not a link.
en.RETENTION_1: Files live locally: migrating means copying a folder. That is the lowest possible lock-in, and the most counter-intuitive retention design here.
en.RETENTION_2: What is actually hard to move is the plugin combination and vault structure — one reviewer spent "probably an entire week customizing it" before it felt right.
en.RETENTION_3: A daily-note habit builds up: "It's usually the first thing I open in the morning" appears verbatim in a review.
en.GROWTH_LOOP_1_DETAIL: 10,194 plugins and 1,000 themes on the community site, 1,214 of them in the AI category. Authors bring their own audience elsewhere (YouTube, GitHub, newsletters), which outsources distribution to the ecosystem. Conversion is not disclosed.
en.GROWTH_LOOP_2_DETAIL: A Product Hunt review: "Deep in a Reddit thread one night, a voice of reason suggested: 'Just use Obsidian.'" Customer acquisition happens in other people's comment sections, not on its own homepage.
en.LOOP_TRIGGER_DETAIL: A thought appears / you read something / a meeting starts
en.LOOP_ACTION_DETAIL: Create a .md file and attach it to existing notes with [[links]]
en.LOOP_REWARD_DETAIL: Notes connect: the graph gains a node, the backlink panel gains a reference — or your agent can read that passage directly
en.LOOP_RETURN_DETAIL: The files stay where they are; the more you accumulate, the less you want to leave; switching cost rises with time
en.LOOP_ONE_LINE_INSIGHT_WHAT_THE_LOOP_ACTU: The loop teaches one thing: ownership is worth more than features. Its real product is not the editor, it is the format promise — and the stronger AI gets, the more that promise is worth.
en.LOOP_FREQ_NOTE_TRIGGER_CONTEXT: Writing is daily; AI calls happen in other tools, not inside this product
en.SURFACE_1_ROLE: Not a database view — just folders on disk. The information architecture is the file system.
en.SURFACE_2_ROLE: Live Preview and source mode; Markdown is both the storage format and the editing surface
en.SURFACE_3_ROLE: Turns [[links]] into a visible network; the emotional entry point of the product
en.SURFACE_4_ROLE: Infinite whiteboard (shipped 2022-12) for arranging cards and embedded web pages freely
en.SURFACE_5_ROLE: Shipped 2025-08: turn any set of notes into a database view. The first time it formally answers Notion's databases.
en.SURFACE_6_ROLE: The factual entrance to 10,194 plugins, and its biggest source of uncertainty
en.IA_LOGIC_PARAGRAPH: There is no database abstraction layer. Folders and links are the entire structure; plugins are bolt-ons. That "no IA" IA is deliberate: it guarantees the content stays readable a decade later, and the price is that every structural capability has to grow out of the user.
en.NAV_INTERACTION_PARAGRAPH: Two input boxes carry all navigation: Ctrl+P for the command palette (run anything) and [[ completion (jump to anything). Learn those two or the product never opens for you.
en.CRAFT_1_DETAIL: No proprietary format, no export flow. That is exactly what makes it readable to AI — a 4-star G2 reviewer: "Claude processes .md files more effectively than pdf or docx"
en.CRAFT_2_NAME: Bidirectional links with a backlink panel
en.CRAFT_2_DETAIL: Type [[ and the link is made; backlinks keep "who references me" permanently in view. Common inheritance from the PKM generation, executed most reliably here.
en.CRAFT_3_DETAIL: The company guards only the core (editing, linking, sync) and hands every long-tail need to the community. Feature coverage is stacked out of 10,194 plugins, which is why the core team can stay tiny.
en.CRAFT_4_DETAIL: Users repeatedly question its practical value ("graph section feels very plain"), yet it remains the single most-shared image of the product.
en.CRAFT_5_DETAIL: Markdown markup renders as soon as the cursor leaves it — source stays controllable, reading stays comfortable.
en.CRAFT_PRINCIPLE: Every craft decision points at one thing: making "the data is yours" an unremarkable default. Features come second.
en.TTV_NOTE_WHAT_HAPPENS_AT_AHA: Hands-on (RanBing): one minute from an empty vault to the first note. The download/install segment was not measured, so no number is given.
en.TRUST_LABEL: Trust mechanism: no sign-up, no telemetry (verifiable)
en.DELIGHT_1: The first time your notes visually connect into a network (a recurring emotional beat in reviews)
en.DELIGHT_2: Discovering Claude or Codex can read the files directly, no export step ("notebook for AI")
en.DELIGHT_3: No upgrade nags, no update pop-ups, no forced sign-up ("never nags me to upgrade or sign up")
en.STRUGGLE_1: Blank canvas, zero guidance (a G2 five-star review's own dislike); hands-on: after install I did not know how to start
en.STRUGGLE_2: Backlinks have to be memorised. Hands-on: 'I can't really use bidirectional links, it demands memory'
en.STRUGGLE_3: Hands-on: it took months before I understood how to use it. It is not hard to use, it has no entrance.
en.REVENUE_MODEL_NAME: Free core + optional service subscriptions + voluntary licenses
en.REVENUE_MODEL_DETAIL: Pricing page as checked in Nov 2026: Sync $4/user/month billed annually, Publish $8/site/month billed annually, Catalyst $25 one-time, Commercial $50/user/year. Sync and Publish carry a 7-day no-questions refund; Catalyst, Commercial and credit are non-refundable. Students, faculty and nonprofit staff get 40% off Sync and Publish, and the page states no other discounts exist.
en.BUSINESS_MODEL_SHORT: Give the software away, sell sync and publishing
en.MON_ENTRY_DETAIL: The free tier is literally labelled "Free without limits" — nothing is locked. You pay for two boundary-crossing things: across devices (Sync) and out into the world (Publish). A pricing structure that never uses core features as leverage is rare.
en.FREE_PAID_BOUNDARY_NAME: The line: multiple devices and public
en.FREE_PAID_DETAIL: Single-device is free forever; sync across devices and publishing cost money. Hands-on: RanBing pays nothing, because he uses an external AI to sync other channels' files into a local folder and backs it up to a drive.
en.UX_MON_HEADLINE: Mostly aligned, with one structural concession
en.UX_MON_DETAIL_ARE_THEY_ALIGNED_OR_IN_TEN: Aligned: no upgrade nags, no crippled features, so trust compounds and trust converts into Sync subscriptions. Misaligned: it makes multi-device a paid boundary while multi-device is a baseline expectation in the 2020s, so this revenue line is structurally exposed to self-hosted workarounds (my judgment).
en.COMP_INTRO: These comparisons are my subjective judgment, not scores or measurements. The built-in-AI column counts official features only, not community plugins.
en.COMP_WHERE_OWN_WINS: Format ownership and ecosystem scale: Logseq's own site advertises 150+ plugins, Obsidian's community site lists 10,194. That is two orders of magnitude — an ecosystem gap, not a feature gap.
en.COMP_WHERE_RIVALS_CATCH: Everything meaning-level: semantic search, automatic structuring, AI that works out of the box. Capacities makes everything an object and surfaces links you never made; Tana has pivoted into a meeting agent; Notion puts AI at the same level as a page. Obsidian is empty here, and appears to intend to stay empty.
en.CHANNEL_1: Third-party word of mouth (Reddit, YouTube, Discord)
en.CHANNEL_2: The built-in audience of plugin and theme authors (10,194 / 1,000)
en.CHANNEL_3: Product Hunt launch cadence (5 launches; Bases 435 upvotes, 1.0 578 upvotes)
en.HORIZONTAL_1: Official pages: Sync (across devices) and Publish (to the web)
en.HORIZONTAL_2: Official page: Enterprise — a customer wall of 10,000+ organizations, a top-level nav item
en.VERTICAL_1: Education, students, nonprofits: 40% off Sync and Publish (pricing FAQ, verbatim)
en.VERTICAL_2: Developers: official developer docs plus Web Clipper and CLI; long-tail integrations are left to the community
en.PLATFORM_1: Plugin API, themes, CSS snippets: public docs, anyone can ship a plugin
en.PLATFORM_2: The local file format is itself an API — scripts, agents and other editors read and write it directly (the actual usage pattern in reviews)
en.CURRENT_AI_USAGE_PARAGRAPH: No built-in AI: homepage, pricing, Sync and Publish pages have no AI slot, and no AI quota in pricing. AI arrives through 1,214 community plugins. Hands-on takes it further, no plugin at all, an external AI reads the local vault directly. AI is not in the product, it is in the user's hands.
en.AGENTIC_CANDIDATE_1: Not shipped (my judgment): an official MCP server or CLI so agents can natively read and write a vault
en.AGENTIC_CANDIDATE_2: Not shipped (my judgment): Sync upgraded from device sync to "context sync for AI"
en.AGENTIC_CANDIDATE_3: Not shipped (my judgment): a vault readability check that tells users which notes AI cannot parse
en.AI_OPPORTUNITY_1: (My judgment) Ship AI readability before AI features: score the vault, flag notes missing structure. It is the only AI position where the product does not have to lie.
en.AI_OPPORTUNITY_2: (My judgment) Officially curate and audit the 1,214 AI plugins, and take over the interpretive authority of the ecosystem.
en.AI_DISRUPTION_RISK: (My judgment) The real threat is not a competitor shipping AI — it is AI clients growing file-system access. Once Claude or ChatGPT can read and write a local folder, users no longer need a note-taking app, only a folder. That is both a gift (the format becomes more valuable) and a dead end (the editor becomes skippable).
en.METRICS_INTRO: Obsidian collects no telemetry (stated on its own site), so it does not have complete data either. What follows is inference used to explain product behaviour — not official fact.
en.NORTH_STAR_WHY: Basis: no sign-up, no telemetry, so the only indirectly observable signals are Sync/Publish subscriptions and plugin downloads. Weekly active vaults are the common upstream of both.
en.INPUT_METRIC_1_WHY: Basis: Sync is its most stable recurring revenue at $4 per user per month
en.INPUT_METRIC_2_WHY: Basis: the Enterprise page states "More than 10,000 organizations" — the only scale number the company exposes
en.INPUT_METRIC_3_WHY: Basis: ecosystem heat is the precondition for acquisition; the public plugin count is a usable trend proxy
en.GUARDRAIL_WHY: Basis: multiple G2 dislikes point at slowdowns from many plugins and breakage on updates — the one experience it cannot afford to break
en.METRIC_BLINDSPOT_WHY: Hands-on took months to cross it. A no-telemetry product cannot see the people who never crossed.
en.FRICTION_1_TITLE: Not hard to use, no entrance
en.FRICTION_1_BODY_WHY_IT_MATTERS: Hands-on: started in April, could not tell a folder from a vault, took months to get it. A G2 five-star user says 'starts as a blank slate'.
en.FRICTION_2_TITLE: Learning curve is the number one complaint
en.FRICTION_2_BODY: Learning curve logs 12 items in Product Hunt's Cons, the top entry. One user says they "spent probably an entire week customizing it" — a week not spent writing.
en.FRICTION_3_TITLE: Plugins are a tax, not a free lunch
en.FRICTION_3_BODY: A Product Hunt review: "a vault held together by nine community plugins is a vault that breaks in nine ways"; a G2 user: "advanced queries, tables, kanban rely on community plugins, which can break on updates". Ecosystem scale is simultaneously the source of fragility.
en.FRICTION_4_BODY: A Product Hunt reviewer: "It finds strings well and ideas badly. If I remember roughly what I thought but not what I typed, I am stuck browsing." This is precisely the slot AI should fill, and the company has not filled it.
en.RISK_INTRO: Only risks with a public basis are listed; likelihood and severity are my judgment, never quantified.
en.RISK_1_LIK: Early signs: users already point agents at their vault
en.RISK_1_MIT: Turn format ownership into a standard: ship MCP/CLI itself (my suggestion)
en.RISK_2_NAME: Governance gap in the plugin ecosystem
en.RISK_2_LIK: Multiple G2/PH mentions of breakage and security worry
en.RISK_2_MIT: Officially audit and curate AI-category plugins (my suggestion)
en.RISK_3_NAME: No telemetry means no iteration data
en.RISK_3_LIK: The site states it collects no telemetry
en.RISK_3_MIT: Offer optional local diagnostics the user chooses to send (my suggestion)
en.RISK_4_NAME: No real collaboration, so teams go elsewhere
en.RISK_4_LIK: G2: shared vaults are not smooth real-time collaboration and can cause conflicts
en.RISK_4_MIT: Do not fight Notion on collaboration; hold the individual plus voluntary-compliance buying (my suggestion)
en.OPP_1_DETAIL_WHAT_HOW_WHY: (My judgment) Offer three doors on first run: import from another tool / start blank / start from a template. Cheap to build, and it hits the top complaint on both Product Hunt and G2.
en.OPP_2_HEADLINE: Make AI readability a first-class citizen
en.OPP_2_DETAIL: (My judgment) Do not build AI; build the checker: which notes lack titles, links, structure. It is the only AI position where the product does not compete with model vendors.
en.OPP_3_HEADLINE: Semantic index as a paid layer
en.OPP_3_DETAIL: (My judgment) Upgrade search from matching strings to matching ideas, bundled into the Sync subscription. The 1,214 AI plugins already prove demand exists; the company only has to absorb it.
en.STRATEGIC_HEADLINE: From note-taking app to the local context standard for AI
en.STRATEGIC_DETAIL_HIGH_IMPACT_BET: (My judgment) Skip AI features and take the protocol position instead: an MCP channel, file conventions, a readability spec. Whoever defines the format collects rent in the AI era.
en.MOONSHOT_HEADLINE: Make the vault the default working directory for agents
en.MOONSHOT_DETAIL_WHY_IT_COULD_RESHAPE_THE: (My judgment) If an agent's default behaviour is "work inside your vault", Obsidian stops being an app and becomes a layer of infrastructure — which is the real endgame value of 10,194 plugins.
en.FINAL_WINS: File ownership plus ecosystem scale: anyone can read the format, anyone can write a plugin, and the two reinforce each other
en.FINAL_BREAKS: Every meaning-level capability is missing: semantic search, automatic structuring, built-in AI conversation — and structurally it does not intend to build them
en.FINAL_MOAT_OR_LACK_THEREOF: Its moat is the format, not the features. Features get copied; a format does not. The stronger AI gets, the more plain text is worth — a rare case of a moat that widens as technology advances.
en.VERDICT_ONE_LINER: Notion is documents as data. Obsidian is documents as connections.
en.VERDICT_BODY_2_3_LINES: Verifiable: no built-in AI, 1,214 community AI plugins; all four official comparison pages return 404; the free tier is unlimited and needs no sign-up. Hands-on (RanBing): one minute to the first note, several months to actually get it. My call: it outsources AI to the outside, which is both its openness and its ceiling.
en.MOAT_REASONING_ONE_LINE: Format ownership 9, ecosystem scale 9, AI capability 3 — weighted to 8
en.TLDR_1_HEADLINE: The company skips AI; users build it
en.TLDR_1_BODY: Zero built-in AI, 1,214 community AI plugins, and users call it "a notebook for AI"
en.TLDR_2_HEADLINE: The moat is the format, not the features
en.TLDR_2_BODY: Plain text in a local folder: cheap to leave, but leaving means giving up every AI-readable context you own
en.TLDR_3_BODY: Search matches strings, not ideas — the semantic layer is the one empty, most expensive square
en.SHOT_1_CAPTION: The hero image: private thoughts. Privacy is the product's first sentence.
en.SHOT_2_CAPTION: A philosopher's card on a Canvas — selling "knowledge you can arrange", not a feature list
en.SHOT_3_CAPTION: A Wikipedia page embedded in the canvas: a local file can hold fragments of the whole web
en.SHOT_4_CAPTION: Sync: shared vaults across devices, $4 per user per month billed annually
en.SHOT_5_CAPTION: A site built with Publish — the outward exit is a paid feature
en.SHOT_6_CAPTION: The finished Publish page: no technical knowledge required (their words)

extra_en.title: Competitive map
extra_en.body:
A verifiable fact first: /compare, /vs, /alternatives and /switch all return 404. Obsidian does not publish comparison pages.

G2's alternatives page instead lists Evernote, Slack, Microsoft Teams, monday and ClickUp. That list is co-mention, not competition: it shows what the same people also use.

PlayerSegmentCloser where
NotionTeam knowledge and collaborationMultiplayer, permissions, procurement
CapacitiesObject-based personal knowledgeWorks on day one without building structure
LogseqOutliner, localDaily flow and block references
AnytypeEncrypted local objectsPrivacy
RoamNetworked notesThe original backlink paradigm

My call: the real fight is with Capacities, Logseq and Anytype. The actual rival is the user's unwillingness to tinker.

extra_en.title: Competitor technical stack
extra_en.body:
ProductStackWhat it locks in
ObsidianLocal Markdown + plugin runtime, no own cloudFormat ownership: files stay readable, AI makes them more valuable
NotionBlock tree + relational DB + permissionsStructure and multiplayer
CapacitiesObject store + date linkage, cloudStructure out of the box
AnytypeEncrypted local objects + own syncPrivacy

[inferred] The stack does almost nothing for AI, but it does the harder thing: it keeps data in a format any AI can read. The moat is the format, not the features. Features get matched in a quarter, formats do not, and stronger AI makes plain text worth more.

extra_en.title: Transferable opportunities
extra_en.body:
WeaknessMove it toOpportunity
No entrance, months to get itOnboarding, tool migrationSet the vault up for people, one-off, no SaaS needed
Plugins are a taxNon-technical usersPre-configured scenario vaults, selling 'works out of the box'
Sync is paid and easily bypassedMulti-device users who won't subscribeLocal-first sync, but collides with the free tier
Weak on non-text materialResearch-heavy usersA pre-layer turning media into searchable text

My call: the first one is the lightest, and it is exactly my own bottleneck.

extra_en.title: Traffic and monetisation
extra_en.body:
QuestionAnswerBasis
Whose pocketIndividual subscriptions, not enterprise budget. Sync $4/user/mo, Publish $8/site/mo, Catalyst $25 one-off, Commercial $50/user/yrPricing page
How long[inferred] As long as plain text stays the most AI-readable formatZero built-in AI; 1,214 community plugins
Why youStructural arbitrage: a decade of local, free and extensible trustNo comparison pages, no ad spend

Traffic: almost no breakout, heavy long tail. Plugin directory, tutorials, YouTube reviews, SEO, all built by the community. Growth is grown, not bought.

Monetisation: the software is free, the money is in cross-device and publishing. The weak beam, [inferred], is that it has exactly one paid reason, and that reason is easy to bypass with iCloud, Git or a NAS. The hands-on user pays nothing and never needed to.

extra_zh.title: 对标竞品地图
extra_zh.body:
先看一个可核实的事实。Obsidian 官网有 /compare、/vs、/alternatives、/switch 四个路径，逐个打开全部 404。它不做竞品对比页。

这件事说明它不靠商战获客，靠的是口碑和搜索。反过来，G2 的「替代品」页给了一份名单，Evernote、Slack、Microsoft Teams、monday、ClickUp。这个名单很值得看一眼，因为它不是竞品，是「同一批人同时在用的工具组合」。G2 是按评论共现算的，不是按需求重合算的。

谁抢的哪一段它更近的地方
Notion团队知识库与协作多人、权限、企业采购
Capacities对象化个人知识开箱即用，不用自己搭结构
Logseq大纲式本地笔记日记流与块级引用
Anytype本地加密的对象空间隐私与端到端加密
Roam Research网络化思维笔记早期的双链范式
Evernote / 印象笔记沉淀型收集存量用户与剪藏习惯

我的判断，真正在同一格的是 Capacities、Logseq、Anytype 这三个。Notion 不在同一格，因为它是团队的；Evernote 那批是上一代的遗存。Obsidian 的对手其实不是任何一个产品，是「用户懒得折腾」这件事。

extra_zh.title: 竞品技术底座
extra_zh.body:
技术底子决定它接得住什么，也决定它会不会被替换。

产品底座被锁住的能力
Obsidian本地 Markdown 文件 + 插件运行时，无自有云格式所有权。文件永远可读，AI 越强它越值钱
NotionBlock 树 + 关系型数据库 + 权限结构化与团队协作
Capacities对象库 + 日期关联，云端开箱结构与自动关联
Logseq大纲 + 本地 Markdown块级引用与日记流
Anytype本地加密对象 + 自建同步隐私与去中心化

[推断] Obsidian 的技术底子几乎不为 AI 做任何事，但它做对了一件更难的事，把数据放在一个任何 AI 都能读的格式里。所以它的护城河不是功能，是格式。功能三个月被追平，格式不会，而且 AI 越强，纯文本越值钱。

代价也很清楚。插件是税，PH 上有人原话写「靠九个社区插件撑起来的库，会在九个地方坏」。这不是技术债，是架构选择的后遗症。

extra_zh.title: 可迁移的机会
extra_zh.body:
这一节全是我的判断。

它弱在哪换到哪会带来什么机会
没有入口，几个月才悟出用法入职、换工具、内容迁移做「帮人把库搭起来」的服务或工具，一单一次，不用做 SaaS
插件是税，出问题要自己排查非技术用户、行业从业者预配置好的场景库，卖的是「开箱就对」，不是自由度
同步要钱，且被 iCloud 绕过多设备但不想付订阅的人本地优先 + 按需同步的轻方案，但撞在官方的免费策略上，很难收费
非文本资料（视频、图文、扫描件）处理弱研究型、投研型用户把非文本变成可检索文本的前置层，这是它主动让出的场景

我的判断，最轻的是第一个。它跟我自己的处境一样，我四月开始用，卡在入口。这个卡点是可以被服务化的。

extra_zh.title: 流量与变现拆解
extra_zh.body:
框架来自我在 GetNote 里写的《关于流量变现交易的商业逻辑思考笔记》，三问，钱从谁兜里出、还能拿多久、凭什么你拿到。

套利三问Obsidian 的答案依据
钱从谁兜里出个人用户的订阅，不是企业预算。Sync $4/人/月、Publish $8/站/月、Catalyst $25 一次性、Commercial $50/人/年官方定价页
还能拿多久[推断] 只要纯文本还是 AI 最友好的格式，这个位置就稳；风险在于 AI 产品自己开始吃笔记这个场景官方零 AI 功能，社区 1,214 个 AI 插件
凭什么你拿到结构性套利。它用十年时间攒下「本地 + 免费 + 可扩展」这三件信任资产，别人短期堆不出来不做竞品对比页，也不买量

流量这一侧：几乎不吃爆款，吃的是长尾。插件目录、教程、YouTube 测评、SEO，都是别人替它铺的。它的增长不是投放出来的，是社区自己长出来的。

变现这一侧：软件白送，卖的是「跨设备」和「对公开」。这个结构的问题在于，它只有一个收费理由（同步），而同步恰恰是最容易被 iCloud、Git、坚果云绕过的一环。实测（燃冰）就是零付费用户，他压根没这个需求。

[推断] 所以它最脆的一根梁不是 AI 缺失，是它没有第二个收费理由。AI 时代本来可以是第二个理由，但它把这个理由让给了社区。
